description: This source file implements the GStreamerWebAudioPlayerClient class, which manages audio playback via GStreamer, including opening, closing, playing, pausing, setting end-of-stream, handling new audio samples, and managing backend communication and configuration. It also includes utility functions for parsing audio formats and handling callbacks.

classes.name: GStreamerWebAudioPlayerClient
classes.description: A class that manages WebAudio playback using GStreamer, handling backend communication, buffer management, and state notifications.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Initializes the audio playback with given GStreamer caps, parsing format, rate, channels, and configuring backend accordingly.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the audio playback, destroying backend and stopping timers.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Signals end of stream, pushing remaining samples if any.

methods.name: isOpen
methods.description: Returns whether the player is currently open.

methods.name: notifyPushSamplesTimerExpired
methods.description: Callback invoked when the push samples timer expires to process buffered samples.

methods.name: notifyNewSample
methods.description: Handles new GstBuffer sample, adding it to buffer queue and triggering sample push.

methods.name: pushSamples
methods.description: Processes buffered samples, writes to backend, manages leftover data, and handles EOS.

methods.name: isNewConfig
methods.description: Determines if the current configuration differs from the previous, requiring reinitialization.

methods.name: notifyState
methods.description: Notifies external callbacks of the current WebAudioPlayerState.
